app_sub: Read, listen and memorize while you work
recite_sub: Choose a surah, a mode and a reciter. The verses appear above your windows without getting in your way.
mode_desc_recite: Plays the reciter and the text follows the recitation, verse by verse and page by page.
mode_desc_memorize: Silent: no audio. Verses appear one after another on their own, at the pace you set here.
mode_desc_manual: Silent: the text only moves when you press Super+Alt+→ (e.g. while a recitation plays on YouTube).
word_sync_desc: Uses quran.com word timings when the reciter has them (Alafasy, Sudais, Husary, Minshawi, Abdul Basit, Shatri, Shuraim…).
adv_reciter_desc: Uses the selected reciter's real verse timings, without playing audio. Speed applies.
hint_reveal: Show first words, then the verse
hint_fade: Show the verse, then hide it (recite from memory)
manual_desc: Super+Alt+→ shows the next page or verse, Super+Alt+← goes back.
offline: Offline — could not load the lists
search_reciter: Search reciter — English or Arabic (e.g. husary, ahmed bin taleb)
rec_hint_recite: Double-click a reciter to start. ⤓ = surahs downloaded for offline use.
rec_hint_memorize: The reciter is only used for “At the reciter's pace”.
rec_hint_manual: The reciter is not used in manual mode.
appearance_sub: Choose how the verses appear on your screen. Changes apply instantly.
layout_desc: Text never shrinks. A verse longer than the line limit is split into pages; the next verse only starts after the last page.
interface_desc: Font of this window (not the Quran text).
downloads_sub: Save recitations to your PC so they play offline. Text and timings are saved too.
dl_hint: Pick a reciter on the Recite page, then download.
library_desc: Reciters with downloaded surahs. Click one to select it.
ov_no_timing: No verse timings for surah {s} with this reciter — choose another reciter
ov_stopped: Playback stopped (no internet?) — press Super+Alt+Space to try again
show_on_screen_tip: Turn the on-screen verses on or off. The recitation keeps playing. (Super+Alt+H)
link_title: Recitation from a link or file
link_sub: Paste a YouTube video or an MP3 link, or choose an audio file. The verses are matched to the recitation automatically.
not_found_in_title: Could not recognise the surah from the title. Choose it on the left.
stage_references: Comparing with reciters that have timings…
q_fair: fair, a correction or two may help
need_ytdlp: Video links need yt-dlp. Install it with:  pip install --user yt-dlp
fix_hint: While it plays: if a verse appears late, press Super+Alt+→ the moment it starts; if it appears early, press Super+Alt+←. Each correction is saved.
no_recordings: Nothing yet. Synced links and files appear here and in the reciter list.
mine_dl: Your recording is already on this computer.
browser_sub: Play a recitation video in Firefox or Chrome, then pick it here. It is synced once; after that the verses follow the video, even when you pause or skip.
listen_note: To find where the video is, the app listens to your speakers for a few seconds now and then. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
browser_none: Nothing is playing in a browser right now. Start the video, then it appears here.
browser_needs_sync: Not synced yet. Syncing takes about a minute for a long surah.
no_video_link: This player does not share the video's link, so it can't be synced.
pick_surah_sync: The title does not say which surah this is. Choose it in the Surah list, then press Sync as …
poor_check_surah: Few verses matched. Check that the surah is right; if not, choose it and sync again.
